audience: small businesses and accountants who do invoicing and bookkeeping in Billy

useCases.title: Find unpaid invoices past their due date
useCases.text: The AI lists sales invoices by state and paid status with due date, amount and balance, and shows which customers owe money.

useCases.title: Total what you invoiced in a period
useCases.text: The AI lists sales invoices and credit notes for a date range or period, and sums the amount and tax.

useCases.title: Review supplier bills waiting for approval
useCases.text: The AI lists bills by state, supplier, dates or paid status and opens one bill with its lines.

useCases.title: Check bank lines and ledger postings
useCases.text: The AI lists the bank-statement lines of one bank account and the ledger postings for an account or period. It only reads; nothing is reconciled.

useCases.title: Add a customer and a draft invoice
useCases.text: The AI creates a contact, then a draft invoice for an existing contact. The draft is not sent; you approve it in Billy.
